en.brief: Electrical test and tag is compliance work: every appliance on a site is tested, tagged and recorded, and the client needs a report they can stand behind. In practice it runs on clipboards, a spreadsheet the client keeps by hand, and whatever the technician remembers from last time.
en.briefTwo: The brief was one system from the plant room to the report: an app a technician can use one-handed with no signal, a console the office can run the business from, and records that mean exactly the same thing in both.
decisions: A shared package holds the domain — ID-range expansion, run collapsing, area grouping, retest arithmetic, the Excel parser and the design tokens — so the phone, the console and the server cannot disagree about what a record means.

The phone is offline first. Records and failure photos queue on the device and sync when there is signal; syncing the same records twice is harmless, and a failure cannot be saved without a reason and a photo.

Nothing is imported blind. A client’s register is parsed and shown first — areas inferred from blank cells, verdicts read from free-text comments — and only then committed as the asset register, the last inspection and the next job.
en.outcome: Shipped as an Expo app for iOS, Android and the web, an installable React console and a Fastify + Prisma API that issues archived PDF reports. Postgres runs in production and the same schema on SQLite in development; 190 tests pass, including one that runs the whole business through HTTP.

en.title: Section 01 house model
en.brief: A presentation model of a two-storey house of the kind built here every week: black board cladding, white joinery, a corrugate gable, a garage wing and a little garden. Nothing about it is remarkable, which is why it has to be right.
decisions: The details are what place it: vertical shiplap stained black, white reveals around every opening, 620 mm eaves, a horizontal slat fence, a letterbox on the boundary.

Cladding is boards with a shadow gap between them rather than a texture, because the shadow line is what you read at a distance — and openings are cut by splitting each board column into the runs the windows leave.
It is presented as a model and not a render: a board with a chamfered edge, planting abstracted to what a model maker would cut, and the sun on a slider.
en.outcome: A section you can walk around, with fourteen named parts and a movable sun. Anyone who has driven through a new subdivision here recognises it without being told where it is.

zh.title: Section 01 住宅沙盘
zh.brief: 一栋两层住宅的沙盘——本地每周都在盖的那种：黑色墙板、白色窗套、波纹钢山墙屋面、车库翼，以及一小片花园。它没有任何特别之处，正因如此才不能做错。
decisions: 决定它属于哪里的是细节：竖向企口板刷黑、每个洞口一圈白色窗套、620 毫米出檐、横向板条围栏，以及立在地界上的信箱。
墙板是带阴影缝的一块块板，而不是一张贴图——远看真正读到的是那条阴影线；洞口的做法是把每一列板按窗户留下的空档切开。
它被当作沙盘而非效果图来呈现：带倒角的底板、按模型师会裁的样子抽象过的植物，以及一根可以推的太阳滑杆。
zh.outcome: 一块可以绕着走的地块，十四个可命名部件，太阳可移动。任何在本地新社区开过车的人，不用被告知就认得出这是哪里。

en.title: Ordinary is the hard part.
en.lede: A sandbox model of a common two-storey house, built from the details that make a house here look like one.
en.brief: A presentation model of a common New Zealand house: two storeys, black and white, a small garden. The studies before it had subjects that carry themselves — a mineral specimen, a watch movement, a planet. A suburban house has no such help.
en.briefTwo: If the proportions or the details are wrong it does not look stylised, it looks foreign. So the work was research as much as modelling: which handful of things, present together, make a house unmistakably from here.
decisions: Vertical shiplap stained black, white reveals around every opening, corrugate roofing, long eaves, a horizontal slat fence and a letterbox on the boundary. Take any one away and the house drifts somewhere else.

Cladding is built as boards with a gap between them, because the shadow line is what reads at a distance. Window openings are cut by splitting each board column into the vertical runs the windows leave behind.
The corrugate is real geometry — a cosine across the sheet, laid down the slope — because at this scale the ripple is what catches the sun and says steel rather than slate.
en.outcome: A section you can walk around: fourteen named parts, a sun on a slider, a house that places itself. The living side and its deck face north, as they would on a real section here.

zh.brief: 一栋新西兰常见住宅的沙盘：两层、黑白、带一小片花园。之前几个研究的题材本身就撑得住场面——矿物标本、钟表机芯、一颗行星。郊区住宅没有这种便宜可占。

en.title: Terra 01 globe study
en.brief: The studies before this one were generated outright. That approach breaks for a planet: no amount of noise will draw you Europe. This one takes two small pieces of public data — coastlines and a city list — and makes everything they touch.
decisions: Data carries the shape and code carries the rest: ocean depth, biome colour, the cloud deck, city glow and the terminator are all computed at load from 200 kB of vectors.
The sun is fixed in world space and the planet turns under it, so day breaks over a coastline instead of sitting still.
The halo fades on how close each line of sight passes to the planet rather than on the silhouette of the sphere drawing it — the difference between an atmosphere and a visible bubble.
en.outcome: A globe that reads as Earth from across a room and holds up when you drag it. The same module runs the case page and the homepage hero, where it is imported only once the hero is on screen and disposed when the page is hidden.

zh.title: Terra 01 地球研究
zh.brief: 之前的两次研究都是纯生成的。这条路在行星上走不通：再多噪声也画不出欧洲。这一次只用两份公开数据——海岸线和城市表——其余一切由它们现场生成。
decisions: 数据负责形状，代码负责其余：海深、地貌配色、云层、城市辉光和晨昏线，全部在加载时由 200 kB 矢量算出。
太阳固定在世界坐标里，行星在它下面自转，于是天亮是从某条海岸线开始的，而不是停在原处。
大气的衰减取决于视线离地球多近，而不是画它的那个球的轮廓——这决定了你看到的是大气层还是一个套在地球外面的泡。
zh.outcome: 一颗隔着房间也认得出的地球，拖动时依然成立。同一个模块同时驱动案例页和首页首屏；在首页上，它只在首屏进入视野时才被载入，页面隐藏时释放。

en.title: A planet has to be recognisable.
en.lede: A lit globe with weather, night cities and traffic, built from two public data files and a great deal of arithmetic.
en.brief: A globe with weather, sunlight and cities visible on the night side — and it had to carry the homepage, not just a case page. That second half set the constraints: it has to hold up at a glance, survive being dragged, and cost a visitor nothing before the first sentence of the page has rendered.
en.briefTwo: It also had to stay honest to how the rest of this library is built. Generating a planet outright was not an option, so the compromise is narrow and stated plainly: shape comes from data, everything else is made.
decisions: Natural Earth coastlines at 1:50m, simplified to a tenth of a degree, and every settlement over 200,000 people. From those: a land mask, a distance-to-land shelf channel that turns coasts turquoise, latitude-banded biomes, and city lights scaled by the log of population.

The cloud deck is baked on the GPU in one pass — fractal noise sampled on the sphere each pixel maps to, so it wraps at the antimeridian and does not pinch at the poles — then banded wet at the equator, dry at the horse latitudes, stormy in the mid-latitudes.
The surface shader reads the deck twice, once underfoot and once offset along the sun, so the clouds throw a shadow on the ground beneath them.
en.outcome: A globe that reads as Earth at a glance: weather moving at its own rate, cities coming on as the terminator passes, a limb that glows because air thins rather than because a sphere was drawn slightly larger. It runs the same code in the case page and the homepage hero.

zh.title: 行星必须认得出来。
zh.lede: 一颗带天气、夜间城市与航路的地球，由两份公开数据和大量运算构成。

zh.brief: 一颗有天气、有日照、夜半球能看见城市灯光的地球——而且它要撑起首页，不只是案例页。后半句定下了约束：一眼要成立、拖得动、并且在页面第一句话渲染出来之前不该让访客付出任何代价。
zh.briefTwo: 它还得对得起这个案例库其余作品的做法。纯生成一颗行星是不可能的，所以妥协被限定得很窄，并且明说：形状来自数据，其余全部现场生成。
decisions: 1:50m 的 Natural Earth 海岸线（简化到十分之一度）加上全部二十万人以上的聚居地。由此得到：陆地遮罩、让海岸泛出青绿的离岸距离通道、按纬度成带的地貌配色，以及按人口对数缩放的城市灯光。
云层在 GPU 上一次烘焙完成——噪声是在每个像素对应的球面位置上采样的，因此在换日线无缝、在两极不打结——再按纬度成带：赤道多雨、副热带干燥、中纬度多风暴。
地表着色器读两次云层，一次在脚下，一次沿太阳方向偏移，于是云会在它下面的地面上投出阴影。
zh.outcome: 一颗一眼就成立的地球：天气以自己的速率移动，城市随晨昏线推移次第亮起，边缘的辉光来自空气变薄，而不是因为多画了一个稍大的球。案例页与首页首屏跑的是同一份代码。

en.title: Movement 01 instrument study
en.brief: The brief pulled two ways: more industrial than the studies before it, and warmer. Most subjects make those fight each other, so the work began by choosing one where they never have — a watch movement, the densest precision engineering people still finish by hand.
decisions: The going train runs on real ratios: one module across the great wheel and its pinions, so they sit at the correct centre distance and turn at the rate their tooth counts demand.
The finishes carry the hand — a guilloché rosette engraved into the plate, perlage ground across the bridges, and no two screw slots left at the same angle.
An eight-bladed iris held the centre for four rounds and read as a flower laid on a mechanism; removing it, not adding to it, is what made the piece work.
en.outcome: Thirteen named parts, five jewels and a hundred and ninety engraved circles, generated in the browser with no model or image files. Hovering names a part and lifts it off the plate, and the index beside it marks the same row.

zh.title: Movement 01 仪器研究
zh.brief: 课题往两个方向拉：比之前的研究更工业，同时更温暖。多数题材里这两者互相打架，所以工作从选题开始——钟表机芯，人类至今仍用手修饰的、最密集的精密工程。
decisions: 轮系跑的是真实传动比：大轮与小齿轮共用一个模数，因而中心距是算出来的，转速由齿数决定。
打磨纹路承载手作：夹板上刻玑镂、桥板上磨珍珠纹，每颗螺丝的一字槽都停在不同角度。
中央的八叶光圈做了四轮，最终看上去像摊在机构上的一朵花；让作品成立的是把它拿掉，而不是再加东西。
zh.outcome: 十三个可命名部件、五颗宝石、一百九十条雕刻曲线，全部在浏览器里生成，没有模型文件也没有图片文件。悬停会报出部件名并把它从夹板上抬起，旁边的索引同步标记同一行。

en.title: Precision that was made by people.
en.lede: An instrument generated at load, where every industrial quality in it is there because a person decided it should be.

facts.label: Deliverables
facts.value: Live scene, part index, case study

en.brief: An earlier study grew an abstract specimen out of noise. Noise is the wrong tool here: it makes organic things, and industry does not look organic — it looks cut, faced, chamfered and measured. But a page made only of that reads cold, and the brief asked for the opposite of cold.
en.briefTwo: A movement resolves the tension, because every industrial quality in it exists for a reason a person decided. The tooth counts come from a ratio someone wanted, the bridges are shaped by hand because they only have to clear the wheels, and the finishes exist purely so the thing is beautiful inside a case nobody opens.
decisions: Real ratios, so the motion is honest. The great wheel and its pinions share one module, which puts them at the exact centre distance and turns each pinion 6.67 times per revolution of the wheel — backwards, as a driven pinion must.

The finishes carry the hand. A guilloché rosette is engraved into the plate, perlage is ground across the bridges, and no two screw slots sit at the same angle. A machine could make all three even; nobody wants them even.
Wood is what the hand touches. The metal is set into a turned walnut dish whose growth rings run oval, never round — the one part a person would actually hold, and it warms every metal around it.
en.outcome: Thirteen named parts, five jewels and a hundred and ninety engraved circles, with not one model or image file. Both halves of the brief hold at once, because the subject was chosen so they would never have to argue.

zh.title: 由人做出来的精密。
zh.lede: 一件在加载时生成的仪器——它身上每一处工业属性，都是因为某个人决定它该如此。

facts.label: 交付物
facts.value: 实时场景、部件索引、案例研究

zh.brief: 此前的一次研究用噪声长出了一颗抽象标本。噪声在这里是错的工具：它做有机的东西，而工业不长成有机的样子——它是被切削、车平、倒角、量过的。但只有这些的页面会很冷，而课题要的正是冷的反面。
zh.briefTwo: 机芯化解了这对矛盾，因为它身上每一处工业属性都源于某个人的决定：齿数来自某人想要的传动比，桥板的形状是随手画的、只需让开轮系，而那些打磨纹路存在的唯一理由，是让这东西在一个没人会打开的壳子里依然好看。
decisions: 真实传动比，让运动是诚实的。大轮与小齿轮共用一个模数，因而中心距精确、每转带动小齿轮 6.67 圈，并且反向——被动齿轮必然如此。
打磨纹路承载手作。夹板上刻玑镂，桥板上磨珍珠纹，没有两颗螺丝的槽停在同一角度。机器可以把这三样做得很均匀，但没有人想要均匀。
木头是手真正触到的部分。金属被嵌进一只车削的胡桃木盘，它的年轮是椭圆而非正圆——这是整件东西上唯一会被握住的地方，也让周围所有金属都暖了下来。

en.title: Specimen 03 dispersive study
en.brief: The reference was a still: a mineral body seen through thick glass, its edges broken into spectra, thin orbits passing in front and behind. A first pass produced it as an exported model — the shape survived the export, the light did not.
decisions: The spectrum is refraction, not a filter: the core is left opaque so it enters the transmission backdrop, and the glass splits it per wavelength as the body turns.
The lighting is a room rather than lamps — a procedural dark studio whose three narrow bright strips are the thing dispersion has to smear.
The wings grow out of the body's own displacement field, so one continuous refracting surface carries the spectrum all the way to the silhouette.
en.outcome: A showcase generated in the browser rather than shipped to it: no model files, no textures, no third-party scripts. It carries live art-direction controls, a lighter tier for phones, and a seed number that rebuilds the same specimen every time.

zh.title: Specimen 03 色散标本
zh.brief: 参考只是一张静帧：厚玻璃里的矿物体，边缘裂成光谱，细环从前后穿过。第一版把它做成了导出模型——形状留下来了，光没有。
decisions: 光谱来自真实折射，而不是后期滤镜：内核保持不透明，进入折射背景，玻璃再按波长把它拆开，随物体转动而变化。
照明是一间房，不是几盏灯。程序生成的暗色影棚里三条窄亮条，正是色散需要拉开的那部分光。
外侧的翼由外壳自身的位移场长出，同一张连续折射面把光谱一直带到轮廓边缘。
zh.outcome: 一个在浏览器里生成、而不是传输过去的展示：没有模型文件、没有贴图、没有第三方脚本。附带实时调参面板、为手机准备的更轻一档，以及一个能复现同一颗标本的种子数。

en.brief: The plate to match was a mineral body inside thick glass, its edges broken into spectra and thin orbits crossing in front and behind. Producing the shape was the easy half: exported as a model and dropped into a page, it read as a grey lump. Everything convincing about the reference lived in the lighting and the refraction, and neither of those survives an export.
en.briefTwo: So the work was not to reproduce a picture but to rebuild the conditions that make it — something that holds up while it turns, on a viewport of any shape, without shipping a single asset.
decisions: Dispersion is physical here. The core is an opaque mesh, so it lands in the renderer's transmission backdrop and the shell refracts it per wavelength — the fringe moves correctly as the body turns, which a screen-space effect never does.

A procedural environment does the lighting: a dark room with a few broad panels and three narrow bright strips, pre-filtered into an environment map. The strips are what smear into spectra; without them glass has nothing to bend.

Separate membranes for the wings read as grey plastic against a dark ground, so they were dropped. The shell's displacement field grows lobes instead, keeping one continuous refracting surface out to the silhouette.
en.outcome: About forty kilobytes of hand-written code over a vendored renderer, generating its own geometry, lighting and grain at load. It survives being turned, resized and re-seeded, drops into any page as a module, and hands the GPU back when the section unmounts.

zh.brief: 要对上的画面，是厚玻璃里的矿物体，边缘裂成光谱，细环在前后穿行。做出形状是容易的那一半：导出成模型放进页面，它就是一坨灰色的东西。参考图里真正成立的部分都在照明和折射上，而这两样都无法随导出一起带走。
zh.briefTwo: 所以要做的不是复制一张图，而是重建让这张图成立的条件——在任意比例的视窗里、在物体转动时都站得住，并且不传输任何素材文件。
decisions: 色散是物理的。内核是不透明网格，因此会进入渲染器的折射背景，外壳再按波长折射它——彩色边随物体转动而正确移动，屏幕空间特效做不到这一点。
照明由程序化环境承担：暗房里几块宽光板加三条窄亮条，预过滤成环境贴图。被拉成光谱的正是那几条亮条；没有它们，玻璃就无光可折。
翼原本做成独立薄片，在暗背景下像灰塑料，于是弃用。改由外壳的位移场长出凸起，让同一张连续折射面一直延伸到轮廓之外。
